title: Testosterone Replacement Therapy Decreases Plasma Paraoxonase 1 Enzyme Activity In Male Patients With Hypogonadism
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is investigating the effect of testosterone treatment on paraoxonase level in male patients with hypogonadotrophic hypogonadism
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Volunteers patients with hypogonadism

Exclusion Criteria:

* Coronary heart disease
* Other pituitary/hypothalamic disorders or other non-hypogonadism diseases
* None was receiving vitamins, lipid-lowering drugs, or other medications known to interfere with PON1 activity, lipid profile, or gonadal function
